acts.title: ACT ONE: ORIENTATION WEEK
acts.card: Dear all, Greetings from the Office of the Official Narrator. This is to inform you that the Official Campus Comic has run for four thousand pages without a single twist, with the continuous support of the institute. Freshers are reminded of the 11 PM induction curfew. Nobody will follow it. P.S. The TAs of this comic (me) requested a salary hike. Management has replied: no. That's fine. I'm fine. What could possibly go wrong? Regards. Bonda!

acts.title: ACT TWO: Things Get Out of Hand
acts.card: Act Two. I have spoken to my lawyer. My lawyer says lamps cannot be sued. My lawyer is also a lamp now. I don't want to talk about it.

acts.title: ACT THREE: Lights Out
acts.card: Act Three. No more Mister Nice Narrator. I know where the fuse box is.

exit_places: JC at 1 AM, ordering an Oreo shake
Devid's Bakery, the only place open past 2 AM
KCIS, which he stormed (the washrooms are lovely)
the R&D Showcase, as a poster
the IIIT Junction flyover diversion, expected back Apr–May 2027
Vindhya again. Different floor. Same floor.
